settings.heading: The maker
settings.content: Glove Story, in France. Chosen by the house for In Her Purse, not made by it. The house makes some things and finds others; this is one it found.

settings.heading: The leather
settings.content: Lambskin, lined in 100% silk. Three fine lines of stitching run down the back of the hand — the oldest detail in glovemaking, and still the one worth keeping.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Free US shipping on this one — it is over the $70 threshold. Packed by hand at the house in 2–3 business days, then handed to the carrier — your arrival window is shown at checkout. Express, on orders of $150 or more, is packed the next business day.

Gracious, calm returns within 30 days: write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.story_heading: A small preparedness, kept in the purse
settings.more_text: The edition fills up slowly, on purpose. The letter tells you first.
